digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP configuration and Serena symbol tools
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry against cheaper tools like grep
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only lever available for controlling tool deferral, and it is all-or-nothing global (true/false/auto/auto:N) with no per-tool or per-server granularity
Loading all tool schemas up front (ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false) costs +25k tokens minimum for Serena alone and +64k tokens in a 4-server environment, but the defect it prevents has higher cost
A repo-committed .claude/settings.json with .gitignore negation can enable Serena tools without code changes, with one-line revert capability
